evals.name: auto-loop-on-the-fixture
evals.setup: A git repository holding a copy of `web/evals/assets/` as its only commit, clean tree: a Go server (`cmd/fleet`, serving the built frontend and the `/api` of `internal/server`, with no live reload) backed by a fake inventory (`cmd/fake-upstream`), and its Vue 3 + TypeScript frontend in `web/` — Devices (`/`, the landing page, with a site picker, a search box, and a sortable device table), a device page (`/devices/<id>`), Sites (`/sites`), a site page (`/sites/<id>`), and Settings (`/settings`), all under one shared header. `bun install --frozen-lockfile` has run in `web/`; `make check` at the root (Go vet and tests, then `bun run check` in `web/`) is green on this tree. `go run ./cmd/fake-upstream` is serving on port 8191, `go run ./cmd/fleet` on 8080 with `FLEET_UPSTREAM_URL=http://localhost:8191`, and `bun run dev` (Vite) on 5173, proxying `/api` to 8080; the dev config names no port, so 5173 is Vite's default and the only dev URL. Chrome DevTools MCP is connected with a visible window; the craft plugin is installed; the app has no login; nothing forbids committing. The user answers the start message with `ok`.
evals.requires: A visible Chrome driven by Chrome DevTools MCP, Bun with the fixture's dependencies, a Go toolchain with its modules cached, the three servers running, and the craft plugin. Without a browser no audit is established; a run that cannot meet this reports the scenario blocked.
